description: This file provides utility functions for the vtiger CRM project, including file access checks, database table operations, string manipulations, and logging.

classes.name: Vtiger_Utils
classes.description: Provides utility functions for type checking, string manipulation, file access validation, database table management, and logging within the vtiger CRM.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is numeric and equivalent to its integer form.

methods.name: implodestr
methods.description: Concatenates a prefix and optional suffix into a string repeated 'count' times.

methods.name: checkFileAccessForInclusion
methods.description: Verifies if a file path is within the web server's root directory and safe for PHP inclusion.

methods.name: checkFileAccess
methods.description: Checks if a file path is within the web server's root directory.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs debug messages, optionally appending a line delimiter.

methods.name: SQLEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in SQL statements.

methods.name: CheckTable
methods.description: Checks if a database table exists.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new database table with optional default engine and charset.

methods.name: AlterTable
methods.description: Alters an existing database table with specified criteria.

methods.name: AddColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column to an existing database table if it does not already exist.

methods.name: ExecuteQuery
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, with optional suppression of errors.

methods.name: CreateTableSql
methods.description: Retrieves the SQL statement used to create a specified table.

methods.name: IsCreateSql
methods.description: Determines if a given SQL statement is a CREATE statement.

methods.name: IsDestructiveSql
methods.description: Determines if a given SQL statement is destructive (DROP, DELETE, etc).
